meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 BGPT 服务器搜索科学论文，并返回从全文提取的结构化数据，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分等 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索含具体实验细节的论文、做系统综述，或需要全文中的定量结果等数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于 CRISPR 基因编辑效率的论文
say.note: 将调用 BGPT 并返回结构化字段。

say.text: 对比这几篇论文使用的研究方法
say.note: 返回每篇论文的方法字段。

say.text: 找有质量评分的临床研究用于证据汇总
say.note: 返回质量评分等元数据。

howto.what_en: Claude can use the BGPT server to search scientific papers and return structured data extracted from full texts, including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and 25+ fields per paper.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find papers with specific experimental details, conduct systematic reviews, or need structured data such as quantitative results from full texts.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells.
say_en.note: Calls BGPT and returns structured fields.

say_en.text: Compare the methods used in these papers.
say_en.note: Returns the methods field for each paper.

say_en.text: Find clinical studies with quality scores for evidence synthesis.
